title: Theoretical Study of the Triplet N4 Potential Energy Surface
authors: Bittererova M., Brinck T., Ostmark H.

bond_params.description: Regular tetrahedron, all N-N edges equal (Re=1.472 A at CCSD(T)/DZP; also 1.458/1.448/1.470/1.466/1.442/1.461 at other listed levels).

species.notes: DUPLICATE of existing molecules.py entry 'N4_Td' (same formula/charge/topology) -- extracted anyway per instructions; gives an independent refined bond length to cross-check against existing entry.

species.method: CCSD(T)/DZP (also B3LYP/DZP, B3LYP/cc-pVTZ, CAS(12,12)/DZP, CAS(12,12)/cc-pVTZ reported)
species.source_note: Table 3, structure '5, D2d (3A1)' -- 'lowest energy triplet with a closed structure' per abstract

bond_params.description: Puckered 4-membered ring, D2d symmetry, all 4 N-N bonds equal by symmetry (R12), one ring angle (R123), one pucker/dihedral angle (phi1234). CCSD(T)/DZP values; other levels also tabulated (B3LYP/DZP: 1.380/88.4/18.9; B3LYP/cc-pVTZ: 1.370/88.5/18.4; CAS(12,12)/DZP: 1.396/89.2/13.5; CAS(12,12)/cc-pVTZ: 1.391/89.2/12.8).

species.notes: NEW species, genuine minimum (real harmonic frequencies reported in Table 3, though authors note T1 diagnostic is somewhat large -0.028- suggesting mild multireference character -- flagging per instructions). Not in existing 70-structure catalog.

species.method: CCSD(T)/DZP (also B3LYP/DZP, B3LYP/cc-pVTZ, CAS(12,12)/DZP, CAS(12,12)/cc-pVTZ reported)

bond_params.description: Second triplet minimum, found by rotating one N2 unit relative to structure 5 (D2d). Atom connectivity per paper's own Figure/atom-numbering (not reproduced in text, only in original figure) -- R12 and R13 are two distinct bonds from a shared atom, R234 an angle, phi2314 a dihedral. Reconstruction requires the original paper's atom-labeling figure to disambiguate exactly which atoms bond to which; flagging suggested_build=UNKNOWN accordingly. CCSD(T)/DZP values shown; other levels also tabulated.

species.notes: NEW species, genuine minimum (all real frequencies in Table 6, no imaginary marked). ~30 kcal/mol higher than structure 5 per all levels. Needs the paper's Figure 1 atom-numbering scheme (not extractable from text alone) to build correctly -- recommend visual read of Figure 1 before attempting geometry construction.

species.method: CCSD(T)/DZP (also B3LYP/DZP, B3LYP/cc-pVTZ, CAS(12,12)/DZP, CAS(12,12)/cc-pVTZ reported)
species.source_note: Table 9, structure '4, Cs (3A'')' -- abstract states this is 'a true minimum at all investigated levels'

bond_params.description: Open-chain: bond order N3-N1 (R13=1.337), N1-N2 (R12=1.289), N2-N4 (R24=1.160); angle at N1 (R213=116.2), angle at N2 (R124=172.0, near-linear). CCSD(T)/DZP values; other levels also tabulated in Table 9.

species.notes: LIKELY THE SAME SPECIES as N4c.pdf's structure '5, Cs, open-chain triplet' (Glukhovtsev & Laiter 1996) -- both papers report an open-chain Cs-symmetry triplet N4 as a genuine minimum with similar bond-length pattern (short terminal ~1.16-1.17, medium/long other bonds). Cross-check both extractions against each other during dedup/build phase; may be the identical physical structure computed independently by two groups.
